$comment: MVP 1B acceptance scenarios mapped to pytest cases under products/code-governance/tests/.

notes.determinism: Clearance request/result fingerprints are deterministic given identical authorization inputs. The upstream Decision-Authority CER carries a wall-clock issued_at/content_hash, so two INDEPENDENT full-pipeline DA runs differ in the CER hash; the evaluator/adapter are pure functions (tested with fixed inputs).
notes.denied: An ineligible ActionGate outcome records NOT_EVALUATED_UPSTREAM_NOT_AUTHORIZED and reconstructs COMPLETE without a fabricated clearance result.
